Reasons for Allowance
The following is an examiner’s statement of reasons for allowance:
None of the prior art alone or in obvious combination absent hindsight discloses applicant’s invention of “a buckling-restrained brace” comprising inter alia a core, a restrainer, first, second and third steel plates having first, second and third yield point, first, second and third yielding segment having the structural limitations as recited in the claims with the inclusion of the limitations towards “a length of the first yielding segment in the axial direction is different from a length of the second and third yielding segments in the axial direction”. Examiner believes that it will not be obvious to one of ordinary skill in the art to modify the prior art of record to reach applicant' s claimed invention without impermissible hindsight.
Any comments considered necessary by applicant must be submitted no later than the payment of the issue fee and, to avoid processing delays, should preferably accompany the issue fee.  Such submissions should be clearly labeled “Comments on Statement of Reasons for Allowance.”
Conclusion
